product_metadata.title: Tumbler Tamer (Blizzard Blue, 30 oz)
features: COMPLETE COMFORT – Ergonomically designed handle is wider and contoured to fit comfortably in your hand. The reinforcements ensure that it strongly supports your tumbler.
description: Perfect accessory for your tumbler. No more slipping, dripping or tripping trying to balance your tumbler when your hands are full. The Tumbler Tamer gives you excellent control and evenly distributes the weight when the tumbler is full. And, it stays put! The rubberized grip ring works great. The Tumbler Tamer is lightweight but tough and built to last. Fits YETI, RTIC, Ozark, SIC, Glacier, Grid Gear, Engel, Epic, Eskimo, Thermik, Titan, Magnum Steel, Kodiak, Boss, Polar Drifter, Polar Pad, Smart, ICONIQ, Bison, K2, Smart, Zero, Kryo Kup, Iceberg and Frosti tumblers. Does not fit Simple Modern Tumblers. Listing is for handle only. Tumbler is not included. Benefits and Features: Instantly makes your tumbler easy to hold & carry even when your hands are full. Comfortable grip area that conforms to your hand & evenly distributes the weight when the tumbler is full. Simple to install & remove. Fits perfectly! Rings are designed to firmly hold your tumbler. Built to last. The Tumbler Tamer is strong & durable. Fits most car, boat and chair cup holders. Easy to clean – We recommend hand washing but it can be put in the top rack of the dishwasher. Ships in its own protective box and not just tossed into a plastic bag. Ready to use. No stickers to remove. 100% satisfaction guaranteed. What’s in the box: Tumbler Tamer handle Instruction card
